notes: REF-BM-03: only post-save editing exists; save form takes URL only with no pre-save preview/edit of collected title/description. REF-BM-04: url/title/description/tags editable but no note field exists to edit. REF-BM-12: full-text search covers title/description/url only; no note field exists so note is not searched. REF-BM-14: no #tag syntax in the query; tag filtering is only via checkboxes/chips. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesised groups; search text is implicit AND of words only. REF-BM-16: exact-phrase matching exists but via a separate 'Exact phrase' field, not quoted-phrase syntax within the search term. REF-BM-23: no note field and no markdown rendering anywhere. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive snapshot integration. REF-BM-29: bundles save search term + included labels + labelMode, but support only a domain exclude-site field, not excluded tags.
